footer: General guidance from dementia care practitioners and search teams. Not medical advice.

sourceRoles.practitioner: general guidance from dementia care practitioners, in our own words
sourceRoles.search_team: general guidance from search and rescue teams, in our own words
sourceRoles.family: the family's own words from the profile

may_not_respond.text: They may not answer when called. Search with your eyes.

approach_calm.text: Come from the front. Speak softly. Be patient.

likely_to_hide.text: They may hide. Check under cover, in brush and inside structures.

afraid_of_uniforms.text: Uniforms may frighten them. Send someone in plain clothes first if you can.

validate_feelings.text: If they see or believe things that are not real, do not argue. Say you understand how they feel.
validate_feelings.shownWhen: flags.hallucinationsOrDelusions, or dementiaType lewy_body when the family shares it

looking_for_home.text: They may say they are looking for home.

gait_unsteady.text: Their walk may look unsteady, like someone who has been drinking. It can be their condition.

freezing.text: Their feet may stop moving. Wait. Do not pull.

fall_risk.text: High fall risk. Help them sit. Stand up slowly.

soft_voice.text: Their voice may be very soft. Answers may be slow or not come.

fluctuates.text: How clear they are can change fast.

sensitive_to_light.text: Do not shine a light in their face.

may_strike_out.text: They may push or strike out. Keep space.

medication_alert.text: Tell medics: sensitive to some medicines. Look for a medical alert wallet card.

medication_timing.text: Tell medics how long they have been missing. Medicine timing matters.
